name: @octridev/neon
description:
**Unofficial SDK.** Generated by [Octri](https://octri.dev) from Neon's public OpenAPI specification to showcase Octri's SDK generator. It is not affiliated with, maintained, or endorsed by Neon.

The Neon API is the management API for Neon. Use it to provision, configure, and manage resources such as projects, branches, databases, roles, functions, and object storage.

See the [Neon API reference](https://neon.com/docs/reference/api) for details, and [Manage API keys](https://neon.com/docs/manage/api-keys/) to create and use API keys.
